rubrics.justification: It correctly identifies a blastocyst with thinning zona, but it over-interprets image details by asserting heterogeneous/vacuolated ICM, loosely organized TE, and downgrading the documented 3AA to 3BB-3AB without strong visual support from this single image.

It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, recurrent ectopic history, prior IVF outcomes, sperm factors, BMI, lifestyle, and endometrial thickness into prognosis and transfer considerations.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around ectopic risk and endometriosis, though the probability deductions are somewhat subjective and partly depend on an arguably overstated morphology concern.

Many recommendations are reasonable and guideline-consistent (ectopic surveillance, structural assessment, consideration of tubal disease), but ERA, microbiome testing, NK-cell testing, routine immunology/thrombophilia workup, aspirin/prednisolone suggestions, and strong salpingectomy framing go beyond standard evidence-based guideline support.
It provides clear, specific next steps for immediate transfer management, ectopic monitoring, investigations, and future cycle planning, with practical timelines and alternatives.
